title: Especialista em Customer Success
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista em Customer Success em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

ESPECIALISTA EM CUSTOMER SUCCESS   100% remoto Remuneração alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia para propor, criar e testar novas soluções Cultura colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento  SOBRE A ADAFLOW  A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior. Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer. Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente. Conheça mais em:  O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER  Você é o ponto de contato direto entre o cliente e a Adaflow. Atende com autonomia, escuta com atenção, diagnostica com critério e resolve com precisão. Cada interação vira contexto, cada problema vira aprendizado, cada feedback vira melhoria. Na prática, isso significa: Atuar na linha de frente nos canais oficiais da Adaflow: WhatsApp, e-mail, chat na plataforma/site e no sistema de tickets, mantendo sempre o tom de voz da empresa. Ler o histórico do cliente antes de atender. Contexto é o que diferencia um atendimento bom de um excelente. Acompanhar cada chamado do início ao fim, garantindo o cumprimento dos SLAs. Realizar follow-up ativo para confirmar a resolução dos problemas e medir a satisfação (NPS, CSAT). Conduzir reuniões com clientes sempre que o caso exigir um alinhamento mais próximo. Conhecer profundamente o serviço prestado e o funcionamento do produto. Diagnosticar problemas relatados, identificar a causa raiz e propor soluções adequadas, sem depender de roteiros engessados. Prestar suporte de níveis 1 e 2, escalando casos complexos às áreas responsáveis quando necessário. Orientar clientes sobre o uso correto da plataforma, de produtos, serviços e funcionalidades. Sinalizar imediatamente sinais de cancelamento e de risco de churn, acionando as áreas responsáveis para ações de retenção. Documentar todas as interações, soluções aplicadas e feedbacks no sistema, mantendo o histórico do cliente sempre atualizado e útil. Contribuir ativamente para a base de conhecimento (FAQ, artigos de ajuda, scripts de atendimento), transformando aprendizados do dia a dia em material reaproveitável pelo time. Identificar padrões recorrentes de problemas e abrir tickets estruturados para os times de produto, engenharia, operações ou tecnologia, com contexto suficiente para acelerar a solução. Coletar, consolidar e traduzir o feedback dos clientes em aprendizado real para o produto e os processos. Não é só registrar: é interpretar, priorizar e comunicar com contexto para quem decide. Mapear padrões, identificar pontos de atrito e propor melhorias na experiência ponta a ponta é parte central do trabalho, não um extra. Acompanhar indicadores como tempo de resposta e de adoção, usando os dados para tomar decisões, propor mudanças e comunicar o status de forma proativa. Antecipar problemas antes que o cliente precise abrir um chamado. Atendimento de verdade é o que evita o próximo ticket.  O QUE A GENTE PROCURA  Experiência prática em atendimento ou no sucesso do cliente, especialmente em tecnologia, contabilidade, SaaS ou Fintech. Noções sobre rotinas financeiras, contábeis e/ou fiscais: você não precisa ser contador(a), mas precisa entender o contexto do cliente. Comunicação escrita e verbal excelente: clara, direta e empática.  Visão analítica: volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e CSAT fazem parte do seu dia a dia. Autonomia real para atuar em ambiente remoto e dinâmico. Você organiza o próprio trabalho. Repertório de ferramentas: Cloud Humans, Intercom, Take Blip, Zendesk, Zenvia, Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares.  Inteligência emocional para lidar com clientes insatisfeitos.  DIFERENCIAIS  Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda.  Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita: somos uma empresa global. Formação em contabilidade ou estudantes de ciências contábeis. Experiência em documentação de processos/Help Center. Domínio de ferramentas de análise e métricas de CS: Notion, Looker Studio, planilhas avançadas. Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e produto: você busca entender como funciona o que está atendendo.  NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO  Se você precisa de um script para tomar uma decisão, de alguém te dizendo o que fazer a cada passo, ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, há muitas empresas por aí que vão te receber bem. Essa não é uma delas. Mas se você quer elevar o atendimento de uma empresa que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, aprender rápido, evoluir com quem coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você! Se identificou?   Se inscreva pelo link:

A posição combina atividades de sustentação (AMS), troubleshooting avançado e desenvolvimento evolutivo, exigindo profundidade técnica e capacidade de atuar em cenários complexos, muitas vezes com baixa documentação. Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje. Quais são nossos valores?  - Somos pessoas servindo pessoas - Pensamos e agimos como donos - Temos gana por performance - Crescemos e aprendemos juntos - Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade - Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades. Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

title: Engenheiro de IA Sr.
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Sr. em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições  Construir e evoluir a arquitetura central da plataforma de agentes de IA, garantindo padronização, governança e alta reusabilidade. Construir e integrar mecanismos robustos de tracking, métricas, avaliação, logging, observabilidade e auditoria — elementos essenciais para o ciclo de vida dos agentes. Avaliar iniciativas com agentes de IA entendendo suas necessidades, padrões de comportamento, interações e requisitos de orquestração. Contribuir para a internalização de componentes críticos, garantindo controle, segurança e consistência do ecossistema. Conectar-se com outras iniciativas de IA, garantindo alinhamento técnico e compartilhamento de aprendizados. Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos, com habilidade para projetar e implementar soluções escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade. Experiência com plataformas ou pipelines de apps ou machine learning. Experiência prática com agentes de IA, orquestradores ou frameworks como LangChain, LlamaIndex, SpringAI ou equivalentes. Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software em ambientes de alta complexidade. Experiência com ambientes Cloud (AWS, OCI). Conhecimento em técnicas de embedding, vetorização e RAG. Noções de segurança de prompts e mitigação de prompt injection.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) ServiceNow
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) ServiceNow em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Já pensou em Somar no CSC de um dos maiores grupos empresariais do Brasil?  Somos o UltraCSC+, um Centro de Soluções Compartilhadas criado para facilitar a gestão do dia a dia das empresas do Grupo Ultra, promovendo mais eficiência e produtividade em processos transacionais. Você soma com nosso crescimento!  Aqui você é o protagonista da transformação que queremos. A sua paixão, senso de dono, responsabilidade e inconformismo são os combustíveis para chegarmos mais longe. Sobre a área  Atuar como referência técnica e funcional da plataforma ServiceNow , sendo responsável pela sustentação avançada, evolução contínua e governança da solução, assegurando alta disponibilidade, qualidade dos serviços e aderência aos processos de Gestão de Serviços de TI (ITSM). O profissional atua de forma autônoma e consultiva, liderando tecnicamente demandas de média e alta complexidade, desenvolvimentos no ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code , automações de workflows, integrações e iniciativas de automação e uso responsável de Inteligência Artificial , garantindo conformidade com políticas corporativas, requisitos de auditoria, segurança da informação e boas práticas de mercado (ITIL). No seu dia a dia você focará em:  Sustentação e Operação ITSM  Atuar de forma sênior na sustentação da plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho, disponibilidade e qualidade das entregas; Atuar nos processos de Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD) , assegurando correta execução, priorização, categorização, registro e encerramento; Atuar como ponto de escalonamento técnico para chamados de maior complexidade.  Evolução da Plataforma e Desenvolvimento  Desenvolver, evoluir e manter soluções utilizando ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code;  Atuar com Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies e Catalog Items , garantindo aderência às boas práticas da plataforma; Avaliar impactos técnicos e funcionais de mudanças, releases, upgrades e novas funcionalidades; Conduzir e revisar testes técnicos e funcionais, garantindo qualidade antes de implantações em produção.  Análise, Melhoria Contínua e Governança  Conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) , propondo e implementando soluções definitivas para incidentes recorrentes. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos, dados e fluxos da plataforma; Garantir aderência a controles internos, auditorias, compliance e segurança da informação. title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Quem somos?  Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds.   Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy:  Fazer acontecer:  A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito.  Jogar limpo:  Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente:  Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido:  Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro:  Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1:  Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho.  Feito é melhor que perfeito:  A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.    Qual o desafio?  Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados.   O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?  A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.    O que esperamos de você?  Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe:  Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação:  Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas:  Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia:  Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.    Quais são os requisitos?  Experiência de 3+ anos  em desenvolvimento de software; Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript  em produção  Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP  em produção; Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web  em produção; Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem; Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ); Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS  e/ou Next.js; Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID); Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código; Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.  Será um diferencial:  Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços; Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform; Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.); Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2); Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível:  Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto  (para candidatos de outras localidades); Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ; 6 dias de folga anuais + folga de aniversário; Bônus de indicação; Bônus de equipe; Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR); Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador; Horários flexíveis; Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!  Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Professor de Espanhol em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: LATAM Decom Project Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para LATAM Decom Project Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company  Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries. About the Role  The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams. Responsibilities  Program & Project Delivery  Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations. Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control. Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions. Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.  Vendor & MSP Management  Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services. Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs. Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.  Cross-Functional Coordination  Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines. Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs. Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.  Delivery Governance & Compliance  Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers. Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce).  Reporting & Metrics  Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations. Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.  Qualifications  8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments. Experience working with or within hyperscalers. Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations. Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds. Proficiency with PM tools. Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills. Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.  Preferred Skills  PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications. Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.  Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Linux Systems Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer  Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit 01 About the role  We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own  Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.  03 What you bring  MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.  NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot.  04 The kind of engineer this work asks for  Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for  APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio:  Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos:  Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.  Requisitos e qualificações  Ecossistema SAP:  Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno:  Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud:  Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica:  Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis:  Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.  #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us  Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description  As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection  • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats  • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production  • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases  • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value  • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling  • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time  • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS  • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience  • Strong Python skills  • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3  • Real production experience with ML on AWS  • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning  • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data  • Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content  • A strong eye for correctness and data quality  • Business level English  • The ability to work independently in a small remote team  • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions  • 12 month B2B contract • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap • Flat structure with direct communication • Production product with real users and real data problems • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence • Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

description:

About the Product  Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI. We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI. Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow. The Team  At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design. We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record. About You  You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts. Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role  Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture  Tech  Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)  What we’re looking for  Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours  What’s in it for you  This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.  As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço). Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio. Principais Responsabilidades  Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade. Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão. Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções. Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis. Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados. Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema. Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança. Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.  Requisitos Necessários  Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação. Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost. Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares). Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas. Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção. Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.  Diferenciais  Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes. Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares. Experiência em varejo. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.  #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

Responsibilities:  Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.  Your profile:  5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams. Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.  **Please submit your CV in English. Our Values:  A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring  What we offer:  At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board. Other Benefits:  Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy. Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. About Fullinfo  Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform. The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources. The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense. The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable. You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly. Your work includes: • Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda  • Building services across the data pipeline  • Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services  • Improving performance and cost efficiency  • Keeping the architecture clean and understandable  • Writing code that is easy to read, test and change  • Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular  • Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success. Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys. Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE  The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO  Learning Lab Architecture & Management  Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.  System Administration & Support  Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management  Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.  Reporting & Documentation  Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.  WHAT IT TAKES  Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.  Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust  in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Conhecimento em Cloud Azure. Experiência com programação/scripting utilizando Python e Java. Conhecimentos em infraestrutura Windows. Capacidade analítica e habilidade para resolução de problemas complexos. Inglês avançado para suporte e interação com times globais.

title: AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead  to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm : a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do  Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution.  On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod.  Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed.  You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle.  You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are  You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if  You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if  You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location  Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. How to apply  To apply, please email  (not DM) the following directly to   and copy  :  Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned  In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery  We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Treasury Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company’s credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements. The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus) • Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries. • Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure. • Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements. • Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines. • Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements. • Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts. • Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations. • Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees. • Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled. • Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure. • Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region. Cash Management & Treasury Operations • Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies. • Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts. • Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations. • Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System. • Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations. • Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements. • Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories. • Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries. • Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities. Stakeholder Management • Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts. • Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations. • Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization. Requirements Education • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Professional Experience • Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees. • Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable. Technical Knowledge • Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds. • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements. • Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2). • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Skills & Competencies • Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills. • Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure. • Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers. • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. • Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Languages • Advanced English (required). • Intermediate Spanish (desirable). Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.
